data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step (Careers, Openings, Country/Team/Time Type filters, Search, open job, APPLY NOW) and names the three filters as parameters; it loses a point on feasibility because the job-opening step is optional and only loosely specified through job_to_open, and it has no explicit action parameter for open versus save.
